name: Exit Ferment Requested

goal.answer: Acknowledge the user's request to exit the current ferment and close it immediately without making any code or planning changes.

criteria.answer:
Ferment proposal reflects the user's explicit 'exit this command' direction.
No files in the project repository are created, modified, or deleted.
Ferment is abandoned/exited rather than advanced to planning or implementation.

constraints.answer: No code changes — the user asked to exit., No new dependencies added by this ferment., Existing project files remain untouched., Do not proceed with any implementation or planning work after the exit request.

assumptions.answer: The user's feedback 'exit this command' supersedes prior 'nothing' clarification. They want to terminate the ferment workflow rather than complete a no-op greeting acknowledgment. No prior questions remain open; the exit direction is unambiguous.

phases.name: Exit ferment immediately
phases.goal: Close the ferment in response to the user's exit request, performing zero work.
phases.description: A single no-op phase that records the exit request and terminates the ferment. No files are edited.

steps.description: Update the ferment proposal to reflect the user's 'exit this command' direction.

verification.command: propose_ferment_scoping returns a proposal whose title and goal explicitly reference exiting the ferment.

steps.description: Confirm no project files were changed during this ferment.

verification.command: git status --porcelain returns no modified or untracked files under the project root after this phase.

phases.summary: Phase completed: the ferment proposal reflects the user's exit request and no project files were changed during this ferment. Pre-existing working-tree changes are documented but outside this ferment's scope.

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.
